sections.heading: Object to a decision
sections.text:
When and how to object to decisions we make about your tax affairs, and which decisions you can object to.

QC33827

Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Follow this step-by-step checklist to object to an ATO decision.

Confirm you're eligible to lodge an objection.

Lodge your objection within the time limit, which varies from 60 days to 4 years depending on what you object to.

Information you need to provide to help us process your objection faster.

How to lodge an objection to an ATO decision. There is no fee to lodge.

How we engage with you when processing your objection, and our responsibilities.

Dispute Assist is a free service that helps vulnerable individuals and small businesses with the objection process.
